name: Suki na Ko ni Kokuttara ♂ Datta Ken ni Tsuite.
original_name: 好きな娘に告ったら♂だった件について。
source:
I transferred schools and lost all my friends. 
On the upside, I fell in love. She was beautiful. 
For days I just watched her at club. 
Hoping to get just a little closer I blurted out how much I liked her. 
That's where our real story begins. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE173420.html]DLsite English[/url]]
